scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply FEED_DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: TZ=UTC vitest run && TZ=UTC vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts
scripts.check: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --strict --config dist/server/wrangler.json

FEED_DB.description: **Content database:** stores your posts, channels, settings, and administrator account. Cloudflare creates it automatically; the suggested name is safe to keep.

MEDIA_BUCKET.description: **Media storage:** stores uploaded images, audio, video, and documents. Cloudflare creates it automatically; the suggested name is safe to keep.

MICROFEED_SETUP_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email used to sign in to the microfeed admin dashboard. It does not need to match your Cloudflare account and is not shown publicly.

MICROFEED_SETUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Choose a password containing 12–128 characters for the microfeed admin dashboard.

MICROFEED_SETUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_CONFIRMAT.description: Enter the same admin dashboard password again.
